name: Image generation
summary: Giving an agent a tool that creates or edits images from a text prompt and optional reference images. Model providers expose it as a built-in tool or a separate API, for example OpenAI's GPT Image models, Google's Gemini image models (Nano Banana) and Black Forest Labs' FLUX.
how: Pick a model or provider and expose a generate-image tool
Pass the prompt plus any reference or mask images
Store the returned image and hand the agent a file path or URL
Iterate with edit calls on the previous image
facts: image_generation tool in the Responses API, GPT Image models
Gemini image models (Nano Banana), SynthID watermark on outputs
FLUX 3, FLUX.2 and FLUX.1 Kontext via API
Per-image cost and latency are higher than text tools
watchOut: Each provider has its own content policies and watermarking
Costs per image can grow quickly in loops
